name: milp_direct_highs
steps: declare non-negative integer variables x (project X units) and y (project Y units)
encode resource_cap: x + y <= 1000; excess: x - y >= 200; bounds x <= 700, y <= 500
minimize 50*x + 30*y with the HiGHS MIP solver at zero MIP gap
report proven optimum and the (x, y) values

name: bounded_enumeration
steps: derive the finite feasible integer ranges: y in 0..500 and x in 0..700
loop over all (x, y) integer pairs and keep those satisfying x + y <= 1000 and x - y >= 200
track the feasible pair that minimizes cost 50*x + 30*y
report the best pair and its cost as the optimum

name: cp_sat_integer
steps: create CP-SAT integer variables x in 0..700 and y in 0..500
add linear constraints x + y <= 1000 and x - y >= 200
minimize the linear objective 50*x + 30*y with OR-Tools CP-SAT
report optimal objective value and the (x, y) values
